propositions: GitHub Actions workflow listings use non-descriptive lowercase name: field values and inconsistent file extensions (.yaml and .yml), making the Actions tab difficult to scan.
Workflow files must be renamed to follow ecosystem-standard lowercase-with-hyphens filenames using .yml extension only, with descriptive Title Case name: fields.

eval.yml must be renamed to prompt-eval.yml with name: set to 'Prompt Eval'; verify-identity.yaml must be renamed to verify-identity.yml with .yml extension; all references in documentation and test files must be updated.
eval-plan-review-container.yml must be deleted as it is closed scaffolding for story da34; references in eval_specs README must be removed.
gerrit-verify.yaml and release.yml filenames must remain unchanged due to external system dependencies (Gerrit dispatch matching and PyPI OIDC trusted-publisher configuration).
All workflow name: values must be rewritten to descriptive Title Case per a locked table; validation must be enforced by test_workflow_names.py; actionlint and workflow-pinning tests must pass.
